factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword states: 'This has contributed to a higher load factor (a measure of seat capacity utilization) of 98.9% in the fourth quarter compared to 96.7% in 2023.' Also mentions 'We see significant growth in the number of trips to Spain throughout 2024' and increased demand for long-haul destinations.

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow and financial stability remained under pressure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows operating activities used EUR 1.6 million (2024) vs generated EUR 3.0 million (2023). Liquidity management section notes 'the Group’s liquidity (total current assets/total current liabilities) and quick ratios... as at 31 December 2024 were 0.51 and 0.51, respectively (0.65 and 0.65 as at 31 December 2023)' indicating deteriorated liquidity.

factual_claims.claim: Operating activities used EUR 1.6 million of cash, compared with an inflow of EUR 3.0 million in 2023, and cash and cash equivalents declined to EUR 394 thousand from EUR 3.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows Net cash flows from operating activities: (1,614) (2024) vs 2,993 (2023). Cash and cash equivalents: 394 (2024) vs 3,347 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: Group borrowings increased to EUR 9.3 million, current liabilities exceeded current assets by EUR 12.5 million, and the liquidity ratio fell to 0.51 from 0.65.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statements of financial position show Total borrowings: 9,250 (2024). Current liabilities: 25,357 vs Current assets: 12,832, difference ~12,525. Liquidity ratio: 80.0% (2024) vs 63.0% (2023) which translates to 0.80 vs 0.63 current ratio, but the candidate uses total current assets/liabilities ratio of 0.51 vs 0.65 as stated in Liquidity management section.

factual_claims.claim: The Group did not meet certain financing covenants at year-end, although waivers were obtained.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14 states: 'As at 31 December 2024, the Group did not comply with all financial and non-financial covenants, under the financing agreements... The waivers were received from “Pagalbos verslui fondas” for ordinary bonds as of 31 December 2024 and from Luminor Bank AS long-term for credit line as of 18 March 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Subsequent financing included a EUR 2.5 million SME Bank loan and EUR 2 million of loans from strategic investor Neset Kockar, who acquired 23.2% of the company.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 29 (Events after the reporting period) details: 'On 29 January, 2025 the Credit Line Agreements has been signed with UAB SME Banks... On 30 April 2025 the Agreements for the sale and purchase of the Company’s shares were signed... On 27 March, 2025 the Loan Agreement has been signed with Mr. Neşat Koçkar... Upon completion of this stage, Neset Kockar will hold 33.19% of the company’s shares.' The candidate references 23.2% acquisition (first stage) and EUR 2 million loans.

factual_claims.claim: Management expects further operational improvements, financing support and synergies with the investor to support a return to profitability, forecasting 2025 EBITDA of EUR 2.0–3.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Liquidity management section states: 'Based on the current forecast, the Group expects to achieve earnings before interest, tax, amortization and depreciation (EBITDA) in the range of EUR 2 million to EUR 3.3 million in 2025.'
